bundle.shortDescription: A user-visible FairyOS presence shell and desktop swarm for Windows.
bundle.longDescription: Faeryware gives RavenOS and FairyOS a resident Windows portal plus a transparent click-through desktop army with six deterministic Digi Fae bodies, eighteen echoes, cursor-aware swarm physics, monitor topology sensing, summon reactions, tray presence, local-only event ingress, notifications, continuity, and an embedded model carrier.
